Indian Ocean noun

classical

Curt. 7.3: merīdiāna regiō ad mare Indicum vergit
Plin. NH 2.167: ex Indicō marī
M-O s.v. Indian Ocean (Marco Polo, 1315)

mare Indicum

Curtius and Pliny use the name of the sea south of India; the ancients did not know the ocean as a whole, and counted much of it part of the mare Rubrum.

Other words

  • ōceanus Indicus

    also used · late Latin · Oros. 1.2.13: ex quā ōceanus Indicus vocārī incipit; Isid. Orig. 14.6.12; M-O s.v. Indian Ocean (Egger)

See also India, Pacific, the Red Sea.
